entities.summary: Ernst Nevanlinna , originally Neovius, was a Finnish politician. He was born in Pielisjärvi, Lieksa, and was professor of economics in the University of Turku and, from 1921 to 1922, editor in chief of Uusi Suomi daily newspaper. At the time, Uusi Suomi was the official newspaper of the conservative Finnish National Coalition Party.
